body.title: The outbox projection and its protocol messages
body.summary: New vscode-free module chat-outbox.ts (sc5): OutboxRow, OutboxView (with runningChat and blockedBy), OutboxAction and projectOutbox(rows, sessionId, ctx), a pure function. protocol.ts gains the host->webview 'outbox' message and the four outbox-* actions, added to HOST_TO_WEBVIEW_TYPES and WEBVIEW_TO_HOST_TYPES.
acceptanceChecks: Processing rows are never outbox rows; positions are 1-based among all waiting rows; failed and not-delivered rows have no position
aheadFromOtherChats counts only other chats' waiting rows ahead of this chat's first waiting row
runningChat names another chat's processing row (here when it is this window's); blockedBy comes from that row's waitingOn
The protocol lists include 'outbox' and the four actions, and the protocol tests' exhaustive lists are updated to match

tests.name: outbox projection: with a turn running, the chat's two waiting messages show places 2 and 3, one message from another chat is ahead, and the running chat is named
outbox projection: processing rows are dropped, failed and not-delivered rows have no place, blockedBy comes from another chat's processing row, attachments are counted and the note is carried
protocol: the host-to-webview and webview-to-host type lists include the outbox message and its four actions
